source: create a game where users cam fly all kinds of vehicles & they will get points after hitting the CP written boards on various similar looking buildings.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - modern city, military airfield, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Use a small modern city with similar-looking buildings and rooftop/side checkpoint boards.

answers.ask: Is this a timed score attack, a race between players to the highest score, or endless free flight?
answers.answer: Make it endless free flight: players earn points whenever they hit checkpoint boards, with their score tracked on a leaderboard.

config.genre_evidence: "users can fly all kinds of vehicles" and the clarified layout is "endless free flight" around a small city. It has checkpoint-board scoring, but no finite race track, lap count, or finish condition, so it is vehicle-operation simulation rather than Racing.
config.evidence: "users can fly all kinds of vehicles" and "checkpoint boards" on "rooftop/side" locations in a small city explicitly call for open-air flight with discrete touchdown/contact targets.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Open Airspace: Open air is the play space, with discrete surfaces to touch down on — rooftops, platforms, landing pads — instead of one continuous ground plane.

INCLUDE:
- Task Station: A built station in the job loop - a pickup bay, a delivery dock, a patient bed, a planting plot.
- Upgrades Bazaar: The central storefront zone — eggs, upgrades, progression shops — that every player has to keep coming back to.
- Purchase Gate: Physical walls blocking higher-tier zones that animate away, drop into the ground, or vanish when bought.
